about.title: A neighbourhood florist that does weddings
about.lead: Lluna Plena Flors is a small shop where the flowers are chosen by hand every week and every order is discussed one to one. Carmen and the team go from a Tuesday bouquet to the whole arch of a ceremony.
about.body1: They work with seasonal flowers and with whatever the market has at its best that day, which is why the catalogue is not a fixed product list: it is a way of working. If you have an idea, a photo, or just a colour in mind, they tell you what can be done with this week's flowers and what it will cost before anything is started.
about.body2: Weddings are a large part of the work: bridal bouquets, arches, table centres and all the flowers for the ceremony and the reception. They also make sympathy tributes and wreaths — work where timing rules, and which they take on the same day whenever they can.
about.pull: Everything we imagined and more. She guided us the whole way while respecting our taste.

menu.title: What you will find
menu.lead: There is no fixed catalogue: this is what leaves the shop most weeks.

bouquet.title: Seasonal bouquet
bouquet.text: Tied by hand with whatever is in that day. Tell us a colour or a budget and we make it.

arrangement.title: Arrangement for the home
arrangement.text: For a dining room, a practice or a shop window. In a basket, a vase or on bark.

centrepiece.title: Table centre
centrepiece.text: For a lunch, a reception or a family celebration. Made with the flowers of the day and the vase you prefer.

wedding.title: Bridal bouquet and buttonholes
wedding.text: Designed with you months ahead, from photographs or a conversation about colours and style.

funeral.title: Wreath and sympathy tribute
funeral.text: Urgent work, handled the same day when possible. Call and we will sort it out.

gift.title: Small gift and thank-you
gift.text: For a birthday, a hospital visit or a thank you, without having to order a whole bouquet.

order.title: Three steps and it is done
order.lead: There is no form and no shopping cart: you talk on the phone or come into the shop, and that is how the bouquet comes out the way you want it.
order.step1Text: Tell us the occasion, the colour and the budget. A reference photo helps.
order.step2Text: We tell you what can be done with this week's flowers and fix the price before making anything.
order.step3Text: Pick it up at the shop or we deliver in Vilanova and the villages around it.
order.areaText: Delivery we can promise is within Vilanova i la Geltrú. For the Garraf and Penedès villages we do not promise anything in advance: call us and we will tell you whether we can get there that day.
areas: Vilanova i la Geltrú — the core of the delivery area
Garraf and Penedès villages — ask us
order.deliveryText: Orders are taken by phone or at the shop. For same-day delivery, call as early in the morning as you can: the flowers have to be made up and go out.

features.title: From the everyday bouquet to the whole wedding
features.lead: The same shop makes a small bouquet and the full flowers of a reception. Pick your occasion.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.text: Bridal bouquet, buttonholes, arch, table centres and all the flowers for the ceremony and the reception. Designed months ahead, made on the day.

funerals.title: Funerals and farewells
funerals.text: Wreaths, sprays and centres for the wake and the burial. This is urgent work and we take it on the same day whenever we can.

birthdays.title: Birthdays and celebrations
birthdays.text: Birthday bouquets, congratulations and small gifts for whoever is turning a year older. Give us a colour and a budget.

seasonal.title: Season and holidays
seasonal.text: Sant Jordi, All Saints, Christmas and Palm Sunday: the shop changes with the calendar and with what the market has.

events.title: Events and businesses
events.text: Openings, launches, restaurants and hotels that want fresh flowers every week.

care.title: Advice and care
care.text: We tell you how to cut the stem, how much water to use and where not to put the vase so it lasts longer.

reviews.title: Weddings planned from abroad, and they worked
reviews.lead: Many of the reviews come from couples who ordered their flowers from overseas and saw them for the first time on the wedding day. These are their words.

emma.text: They made all the floral decor and the bouquets for my April 2025 wedding. I planned it from the US and, without having seen any designs beforehand, it was perfect.
emma.author: Emma Oakley

rachel.text: They made the flowers for my April 2023 wedding. I planned it from the UK and only sent reference photos. I saw the flowers for the first time on the wedding day and was completely blown away.
rachel.author: Rachel Esfahani

dana.text: They did the flowers for our intimate wedding and they were beautiful. I sent Pinterest inspiration photos and they got exactly what I had imagined, maybe even better. Such a kind and professional team.
dana.author: Dana Jones

rocio.text: Carmen handled all the floral decoration for my wedding, with excellent taste and great respect for our personalities. She travelled to different places to deliver everything where it needed to be and followed every comment we made over the months.
rocio.author: Rocío González

imma.text: A lovely place and very kind people. I trusted them with two floral arrangements and came away delighted.
imma.author: Imma Espejo

contact.title: Call and let's talk about the flowers
contact.lead: It is the quickest way: on the phone we tell you what there is, what it costs and when you can have it. Coming into the shop is even better.
contact.callNote: If nobody answers, we are in the middle of making a bouquet: leave a message or try again shortly.
